annotations.title: Scan keywords on my SpyWinAds app

description: Start Facebook Ad Library keyword scans on the user's own SpyWinAds desktop app (it scans from the user's home network). Up to 10 keywords per call, 30 new keywords a day. Keywords someone scanned fully in the last 24 hours return at once from the library (status cached). If the app is closed, not installed, or Facebook is pausing the home network, nothing is queued and the status says so (app_off, no_app, fb_paused) with the next step. Returns a scan_id for spywin_get_scan_status and spywin_get_scan_results.

keywords.description: Product keywords in English, e.g. ["pet hair remover", "under sink organizer"]

name: spywin_queue_keyword_scan
